schema_meta.expiry_rule: when a component no longer fits any one layer, or an axis stops separating configurations
schema_meta.on_expiry: fork to a new version; keep the old records readable

value_rules.axis: an object {"value": number in [0.0, 1.0], "basis": non-blank text} or {"value": "VOID", "reason": non-blank text}
value_rules.text_or_void: a non-blank string, or {"value": "VOID", "reason": non-blank text}
value_rules.blank: an empty string, an empty list where a list of named items is required, or a missing field is refused

components.note: a component with layer 'physical' also carries 'kind' from physical_kinds; version is text_or_void

positions.note: who is text_or_void; latency is an axis. every axis carries its own basis

channels.note: filter_holder is text_or_void; drops is a non-empty list of {name, basis}; to state that nothing was seen dropped, use {"name": "NONE_OBSERVED", "basis": ...}

roles_at_t.rule: derived from positions only, never hand-set; a role is read from positions at a given t, not from the component's name or layer
roles_at_t.derivation: decider if chooses_vs_executes >= DECIDE; else executor if reach_on_world >= REACH; else carrier. any needed axis VOID -> the role is VOID with a reason
roles_at_t.choice: [CHOICE] thresholds set 2026-11-13, printed with every derivation, overridable on the command line
roles_at_t.input_rule: a record may omit roles_at_t; if present it must carry derived_by and equal the derivation, else it is refused as hand-set

authority_chain.note: checked_by, checked_against, verification_method are text_or_void; operated_within_bounds is {value, basis} or VOID with reason; tools_touched lists component ids (empty list allowed only with tools_touched_basis)

maintenance.note: repairable_by is text_or_void; sees_of_rest is an axis; whole_holders is a list of {role, holder_kind, basis} (holder_kind person|system) or VOID with reason

flags.WHOLE_HOLDERS_UNKNOWN: whole_holders is VOID; not read as 0

frame_exit.note: a list of {sees_failure, can_act, path_kind, basis} (path_kind person|check|physical_override) or VOID with reason

flags.CLOSED-FRAME: an empty list: nothing outside the system's own frame can see a failure or act on it

bounds.rule: one entry per component and one with scope 'whole'; no layer is exempt
bounds.note: energy is {value: number >= 0, unit, basis} or VOID with reason; physical_limits is a non-empty list of {name, value, unit, basis} or VOID with reason

design_source.note: was the segmentation of the system chosen for the task, or inherited from segmented domain structure in the training corpus; {value, basis} or VOID with reason
